// Investigation playbooks per capability: what functioning means, the ordered checks, how known failure
// modes differ, and the concrete selectors for today's tools. Edit here and re-import the workflow.
const playbooks = {
  default: `1. Read the alert's labels and annotations; find the object it is about (namespace, workload, node).
2. Check that object's status and recent events (k8s_get, k8s_events).
3. Check the owning controller's logs if the object is managed (pod_logs, tail 100).
4. Check whether any upstream capability in the evidence pack is firing; if so, say the cause is there.
Never: list without a namespace and selector; query logs without a selective stream selector.`,
  'storage.block': `Functioning: Longhorn volumes attach, replicate and report health; Prometheus scrapes longhorn-manager on :9500.
Checks: 1) up{job="longhorn-backend"} and count by node vs kube_node_info. 2) If targets are down: NetworkPolicies in
longhorn-system selecting app=longhorn-manager (k8s_list networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicy, labelSelector or fieldSelector),
and whether any allows ingress from namespace monitoring. 3) longhorn_volume_robustness (1 healthy, 2 degraded, 3 faulted).
4) Longhorn events in longhorn-system.
Tells apart: scrape blocked (pods Running, up=0, policy without a monitoring rule) vs manager down (pods not Ready) vs
volume degraded (robustness 2/3 with up=1).
Bindings: namespace longhorn-system; job longhorn-backend; pods label app=longhorn-manager.`,
  'backup.db': `Functioning: each CloudNativePG Cluster archives WAL and takes scheduled base backups through the barman-cloud plugin.
Checks: 1) cnpg_collector_up and barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_* series for the namespace. 2) The Cluster object
(postgresql.cnpg.io/v1 Cluster) status: conditions ContinuousArchiving and LastBackupSucceeded, spec.plugins.
3) ScheduledBackup and Backup objects in the namespace. 4) Plugin sidecar logs (container plugin-barman-cloud).
Tells apart: no plugin configured (spec.plugins empty: backups were never set up) vs archiving failing (condition False,
S3 errors in logs; check storage.object) vs schedule missing (no ScheduledBackup).
Bindings: CNPG metrics carry namespace; Cluster names end in -db-v<date>.`,
  'backup.volume': `Functioning: Longhorn recurring backups land in the backup target, and the weekly restore verification passes.
Checks: 1) kube_job_failed / kube_cronjob_status_last_successful_time for namespace backup-verification.
2) That Job's pod logs. 3) Longhorn BackupTarget status (longhorn.io/v1beta2 BackupTarget in longhorn-system).
Bindings: namespace backup-verification; backup targets live on the nas (MinIO, versitygw).`,
  'storage.object': `Functioning: S3 endpoints (MinIO, Garage on homelab; MinIO, versitygw on nas) accept PUT/GET/LIST/DELETE.
Checks: 1) the health-canary CronJob results in namespace health-canary. 2) The endpoint's pods and events.
3) Its logs for auth or disk errors. Tells apart: endpoint down vs credentials revoked vs bucket missing.`,
  'storage.nfs': `Functioning: NFS-backed PVCs mount and accept writes. Checks: 1) health-canary storage canary for the NFS class.
2) csi-driver-nfs pods and events. 3) nas.host health (Synology) if the export itself is failing.`,
  'nas.host': `Functioning: the Synology RS1221 serves its RAID volumes with healthy disks.
Checks: 1) raidStatus, diskStatus, diskHealthStatus, diskTemperature series (job prometheus-snmp-exporter, module synology).
2) Synology journal: loki {host="syn-rs1221"}. Never suggest disk operations; report the disk and slot.`,
  'dns.cluster': `Functioning: CoreDNS resolves in-cluster names on every node. Checks: 1) probe_success for the CoreDNS blackbox probe.
2) CoreDNS pods in kube-system (labelSelector k8s-app=kube-dns), restarts and logs. 3) coredns_* error rates.
Tells apart: CoreDNS down vs pod networking broken (check net.pod) vs upstream resolver failing (SERVFAIL in logs).`,
  'gitops': `Functioning: Flux Kustomizations and HelmReleases reconcile to Ready. Checks: 1) gotk_resource_info{ready="False"}.
2) The failing object's status conditions (kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 Kustomization or helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
HelmRelease in flux-system or its namespace). 3) Its source's status (GitRepository/OCIRepository).
Tells apart: build error (message names a file) vs dependency not ready vs source fetch failure vs Helm install timeout.`,
  'cp.api': `Functioning: the apiserver serves requests. Checks: 1) apiserver_request_total error ratio and latency.
2) k3s.service journal for the node: loki {systemd_unit="k3s.service", host="<node>"}. 3) cp.datastore status.`,
  'cp.datastore': `Functioning: embedded etcd has a leader and fsyncs quickly. Checks: 1) etcd_server_has_leader,
etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds. 2) k3s.service journal for slow fdatasync or leader changes. 3) node.disk on that node.`,
  'node.disk': `Functioning: node disks report healthy SMART data and no I/O errors. Checks: 1) smartctl_* series for the device.
2) Kernel journal on the node: loki {syslog_identifier="kernel", host="<node>"} |~ "I/O error|nvme|ata". Report device and node.`,
  'node.resources': `Functioning: nodes are not under memory, disk or PID pressure. Checks: 1) kube_node_status_condition for pressure.
2) node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, top pods by memory on the node. 3) Kernel journal for oom-kill on that host.`,
  'node.kubelet-runtime': `Functioning: kubelet is Ready and runs pods. Checks: 1) kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready"}.
2) Node object conditions (v1 Node). 3) k3s.service journal for PLEG or container runtime errors.`,
  'obs.alerting': `Functioning: rules evaluate and reach Alertmanager. Checks: 1) prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total,
prometheus_notifications_errors_total. 2) Alertmanager and Prometheus pods in monitoring.`,
};

return [{ json: { playbooks } }];

nodes.notes: Counts tokens and tool calls, refuses unbounded calls, and ends the loop on any budget.

nodes.name: MCP Call
nodes.notes: Read-only MCP servers through LiteLLM, scoped by the health-triage virtual key.

nodes.name: Tool Results
nodes.notes: Cuts each result to about 4k tokens and records every call for the evidence check.

nodes.notes: Schema check. Evidence that does not quote a tool result from this session becomes 'inferred'.
